Description
We are new and old, local and global. LCI Melbourne is part of the global LCI Education Network, and was previously the Australian Academy of Design.We have considerable expertise and established networks in the art and design profession both in Melbourne and globally with our sister art and design campuses in Barcelona, Indonesia, Morocco, Vancouver, and Montreal.LCI Melbourne is an Institute of Higher Education and is on the Commonwealth Register of Institutions and Programs for Overseas Students (CRICOS). Our programs are nationally accredited by the Commonwealth Government’s Tertiary Education Quality and Standards Agency (TEQSA).
